claims.subject: visual_arts
claims.value: Hellenistic art widened subject matter and supported multiple expressive/idealizing modes rather than one uniform “Greek” look.
claims.confidence_reason: Museum synthesis describes expanded subject matter, patronage and stylistic diversity across the Hellenistic world.
claims.interpretation: Do not compile Hellenistic as merely Classical Greek plus more drama; choose subject/region/context deliberately.
prompt_implications: Treat Hellenistic visual direction as context-specific and capable of stronger movement, individualized subjects or royal/luxury contexts without forcing a single exaggerated formula.

claims.subject: survival_bias
claims.value: Many Hellenistic sculptures are lost or known through Roman copies; securely dated originals are uneven and stylistic chronology can be uncertain.
claims.confidence_reason: Met specialist publication explicitly discusses lost statuary, sparse bronze survival, Roman-copy dependence and chronology/style uncertainty.
claims.interpretation: A surviving Roman copy or fragment should not be treated as transparent evidence for every aspect of a lost Hellenistic original.
prompt_implications: Keep reconstructed Hellenistic originals distinct from later Roman copies and present uncertain reconstruction details as interpretive rather than canonical.
safer_alternatives: Frame the result as a Hellenistic-inspired reconstruction when exact original form is not securely recoverable.
claims.survival_bias: The surviving record is selective: bronzes were frequently melted down and some Hellenistic works are known principally through Roman copies, so surviving material can distort original prevalence and appearance.

strict_reconstruction.instruction: Do not infer undocumented details from a Roman copy or fragment as certain features of a lost Hellenistic original.

historically_informed.instruction: Use surviving/copy evidence as a bounded reconstruction anchor and label uncertain original details interpretively.

period_drama.instruction: Allow coherent Hellenistic visual conventions while avoiding claims that a later copy proves the exact lost original.

fantasy_hybrid.instruction: Historical reconstruction uncertainty may be stylized deliberately, but keep the hybrid status explicit.
